description: How the artist's Promo settings stand: "Post these without waiting for your approval" (whether the weekly post about their music that Promo proposes, with Audora's Instagram invited as a collaborator, goes out on Instagram and Facebook without their press; TikTok always waits for it), "Keep it going each month" on each campaign between releases (whether its next month is planned on its last day, and what that costs), and "Your week" on each one (which weekdays post, what each is about, on which accounts; none set spreads the posts evenly). Change them with set_promo_settings.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.
